title: Missing X-DNS-Prefetch-Control response header
description: The response omits X-DNS-Prefetch-Control, so the browser default applies and may resolve hostnames referenced by links and subresources before the user follows them. That prefetch discloses which hosts a page references to the DNS resolver, including links the user never visits.
remediation: Send X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: off on pages that link to sensitive or user-specific hosts. Keep the default where prefetch is a deliberate performance choice and the referenced hosts are public.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot observe resolver traffic, so it reports the missing privacy control rather than a measured leak.
